rules.name: Per-LP Allocation Cells Are Formulas
rules.description: Per-LP amounts on the Allocation sheet must stay formula-driven (driver x commitment %, rounded to cents) so the allocation is auditable; hardcoded per-LP values are a defect.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Every per-LP cell in an active component column is a driver-referencing formula; only the single plug LP per vehicle/component may add a trailing literal offset.

rules.name: Vehicle Totals Tie to Drivers
rules.description: Per vehicle and per component, the sum of per-LP allocations must equal the vehicle total row and the vehicle driver cell to the penny.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Per-LP sum = vehicle total = vehicle driver for every vehicle and component, tolerance $0.005.

rules.name: Bottom-Line Totals Tie to Event Gross
rules.description: Components sum to the event gross, vehicle totals sum to each component, and every bottom-line total equals the event gross, penny-exact.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Components, vehicle totals and bottom-line totals all reconcile to the event gross within $0.005.

rules.name: Allocation Refoot and Crossfoot
rules.description: All column totals and subtotals on the Allocation sheet refoot, and every row's total crossfoots to its components.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All totals refoot and all row totals crossfoot, tolerance $0.005.

rules.name: Per-LP Pro-Rata Parity (No Concentrated Plug)
rules.description: On pro-rata components, each LP's allocation must be within $2 of its pure pro-rata share. A component is pro-rata when its per-LP cells are driver x % formulas; components pulled from another tab (e.g. management fees from the fee tab) or set per investor are not checked.
rules.acceptance_criteria: On every pro-rata component, no investor deviates from its pure pro-rata share (commitment basis for calls, contributed-capital basis for distributions) by more than $2.00.

rules.name: Residual Plug Discipline
rules.description: The rounding residual may sit on one LP or be spread across several, as the client prefers, but only on eligible LPs (never the GP, an affiliate or a fee-exempt investor), only on the largest eligible LPs, and only as much as rounding explains.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Per vehicle and component: total plug magnitude <= max($0.50, number of LPs x $0.01); every plugged investor is eligible and among the N largest eligible LPs, where N is the number of plugs; no plug on an inactive component.

rules.name: Commitments and Commitment % Reconcile
rules.description: Per vehicle, investor commitments sum to the vehicle total and commitment % sums to 100% and matches each investor's commitment share.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Commitments tie to the vehicle total; commitment % sums to 100% and is consistent per investor.

rules.name: No Stale Prior-Event Components
rules.query:
Using the COMPUTED FACTS (active and inactive components, with their drivers, totals, non-zero cell counts, whether a header names another event, and, when the prior event's workbook is supplied, which components were active then), check that components from earlier events do not leak into this one. An inactive component may keep an old label, e.g. a distribution column still headed 'Distribution #3' during a capital call; leftover labels only matter on a column that is actually used.

Pass criteria: Every inactive component is zero end-to-end (driver, per-LP cells, totals), and no active component's header names a prior event.

Fail criteria: An inactive component still carries a non-zero driver, per-LP amount or total (stale values bleed into the Summary and the notices), or an active component is still headed with a prior event's label.

needs_review when it cannot be determined which components belong to the current event.
rules.description: Components from a prior call that do not apply to this event must be zeroed across drivers, per-LP cells and totals.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Inactive components are all zero; active components carry no prior-event label (labels on unused columns are fine).

rules.name: Cash Direction and Sign Convention
rules.query:
This rule applies ONLY to the Allocation sheet. If this sheet is not the Allocation sheet, return not_applicable.

Determine the event type from the event header / label (capital call, distribution, or net event). For a capital call, every call-side per-LP amount due must be >= 0, except on components explicitly labelled as a recall, true-up or fee refund. For a distribution, distribution amounts must follow one consistent sign convention across all investors and components. Within a single column, signs must be consistent across investors; a lone investor with the opposite sign is a red flag. Recall / clawback components must carry the opposite sign of the event direction and be netted in totals.

Pass criteria: Signs are consistent with the event direction and internally consistent per column; any negative on a call is on an explicitly labelled recall / true-up component.

Fail criteria: An unexpected negative cash amount on a call-side row, a single investor with a flipped sign within a column, or a recall component summed as a positive.

needs_review when the event type or the sign convention cannot be determined from the sheet.
rules.description: Amounts follow the event's cash direction and one consistent sign convention; unexpected negatives or flipped signs are flagged.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No unexpected negative cash due; signs consistent per column and with the event direction.

rules.name: Allocation Rounding Basis
rules.description: Per-LP allocations carry at most two decimals, and each component keeps one rounding basis. Components may differ, e.g. fees in whole dollars and investment in cents.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No amount carries more than two decimals; within each component, cells are not rounded partly to whole dollars and partly to cents.

rules.name: No Merged Cells Across Component Columns
rules.description: Merged cells across per-period component/driver columns are a structural hazard that hides per-period values.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No merged ranges across component/driver columns on settable rows.

rules.name: Roll-Forward Footing per LP
rules.description: Per LP, Commitment less prior and current contributions (and recallables where modelled) equals Remaining Commitment; no over-contribution or negative unfunded.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Every LP row foots within $0.01; prior contributions <= commitment; remaining >= 0.

rules.name: Current Capital Call Links to This Event
rules.description: Current Capital Call reflects this event's per-LP total, and prior-event funding (Received / Date) cells are cleared.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Current Capital Call = current-event per-LP total; funding cells for the new event are blank.

rules.name: Prior ITD Event Blocks Are Frozen
rules.description: Prior event columns on the ITD sheet must hold frozen values. A live formula into the Allocation sheet that currently reads a non-zero amount fails; one that reads $0 is a warning, since it would corrupt history only once the amount changes.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No prior ITD event block links live to the Allocation sheet with a non-zero value; $0 live links are flagged for review.

rules.name: Current Event Block Present and Classified
rules.query:
Using the COMPUTED FACTS for the current ITD event block (its columns, their component types, their classification X marks on the primary rows, any overlay marks, and which Allocation investors are missing from each column), check the current event block. The primary classification rows are Investment Contributions, Cost Contributions, Recallable Distributions, Non-Recallable Distributions and Tax Withholding. Other marked rows (e.g. 'Mgmt Fees', 'Late Interest') are overlays and may mark columns in addition to their primary row. 'Total' columns carry no mark.

Confirm: (1) a block for the current event exists, appended after the last prior block; (2) its label is written once and is unique; (3) every component column carries an X in exactly one primary row, consistent with its component (Investment -> Investment Contributions; expenses and management fees -> Cost Contributions; distributions -> Recallable or Non-Recallable), overlays allowed and Total columns excluded; (4) every investor with an Allocation amount for a component is populated in the matching column. Participation differs by component (e.g. affiliates pay no management fee), so a column is fully populated when no investor is listed as missing from it.

Pass criteria: The block exists, is uniquely labelled, every component column has exactly one consistent primary X, and no investor is missing.

Fail criteria: No current block, a duplicated or missing label, a component column with no primary X or more than one, an X inconsistent with the component, or an investor missing from a column.

needs_review when a column's component cannot be determined from its sub-header.
rules.description: The current event is appended to the ITD sheet as a new, uniquely labelled block with correct classification markers.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Current block appended, uniquely labelled, one consistent primary X per component column (overlays allowed, totals excluded), fully populated.

rules.name: ITD Cumulative Columns Reconcile
rules.description: ITD cumulative columns equal the sum of their classified event columns (including this event), and Unfunded = Commitment - Total Contributions.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Cumulatives, Unfunded and ITD totals all reconcile within $0.01.

rules.name: Event Numbering and Chronology
rules.description: Event numbers run sequentially per event type and event dates (the due dates shown in the headers) run forward. Transfer blocks do not take part in the numbering. A net event continues the call counter, the distribution counter, or both, depending on the client.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Calls and distributions each number +1 with no gap or repeat; each net event continues at least one counter; header dates never go backwards; transfers are ignored.

rules.name: Check Cells Equal Zero
rules.description: Every control / check cell must read exactly 0.00: the Summary check cells and the check rows or columns on the Allocation, ITD, fee and Merge tabs.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All check cells on every processed sheet equal 0.00, including sub-cent differences.

rules.name: Event Date Validity
rules.description: Notice, due/payment and funding dates must be valid calendar dates, and the due/payment date must be a business day.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All event dates valid; due/payment date on a weekday.

rules.name: Event Date Logical Order
rules.description: Due/payment date follows the notice date, and the current event does not predate the prior event.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All evaluated date pairs are in logical order.

rules.name: Date Display Format
rules.description: Dates render as 'Month D, YYYY' consistently; no serial numbers or malformed month formats.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All dates render legibly and consistently.

rules.name: Accounting Number Format
rules.description: Monetary cells use an accounting format with separators, consistent decimals and parenthesized negatives.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Accounting format with consistent decimals and parenthesized negatives on all monetary cells.

rules.name: No Formula Error Values
rules.description: No #REF!/#NAME?/#VALUE!/#DIV/0!/#N/A errors or '####' overflows on the processed sheets or on any sheet their formulas reference (hidden or not). Unreferenced hidden sheets and the rows of investors no longer active (no commitment, nothing in this event) are ignored.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No error values on the processed and referenced sheets, outside inactive investors' rows.

rules.name: Required Workbook Sheets Present
rules.query:
Confirm the workbook is the fund's full capital-event roll-forward model, not a freshly generated skeleton. Required sheets: (1) an Allocation sheet (name contains 'Allocation', but is not a merge-side sheet such as 'Investran Allocation') carrying the per-vehicle investor register, commitments, commitment %, fee rates and per-component allocation columns; (2) an ITD / Inception-To-Date capital activity sheet (name contains 'ITD') carrying the classification band and per-event column blocks; (3) a Summary sheet; (4) one Merge tab per vehicle (name contains 'Merge'). CONDITIONAL: when the event includes a management-fee component, a fee source tab (e.g. 'MF' or 'Mgmt Fee Calc') must be present; when the workbook drives notice delivery, a 'DX Investor Data' tab is expected. Identify sheets by name and by their header content.

Pass criteria: All required sheets are present, and conditional sheets are present when their condition applies.

Fail criteria: The Allocation, ITD or Summary sheet is missing; the workbook contains only a minimal 2-3 sheet skeleton of hardcoded tables (a 'fresh render' instead of a rolled-forward model); or a management-fee component is allocated with no fee source tab.

needs_review when a sheet is present but its identity is ambiguous from its name and headers (e.g. two sheets both look like the ITD sheet).
rules.description: The workbook must be the fund's full multi-sheet roll-forward model (Allocation, ITD, Summary, per-vehicle Merge tabs, fee tab when fees apply), not a fresh skeleton.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Allocation, ITD and Summary sheets present; Merge tab per vehicle; fee tab present when a fee component is allocated.

rules.name: Merge Tab per Vehicle with Document-System Keys
rules.query:
List the vehicles on the Allocation sheet and the workbook's Merge tabs (identified by their headers, whatever the tab is called). Each vehicle needs a Merge tab carrying, per investor, a Fund ID and an Investor ID column; 'DX Fund ID' and 'DX Investor ID' are the same IDs under another name. Where a File Name column is present, each file name must start with that row's own Fund ID and Investor ID ('{Fund ID}_{Investor ID}_...'), include the fund's legal name, and refer to the CURRENT event - by its event label or by its due date, e.g. via the summary title 'Capital Call - due June 10, 2026'. Separators after the IDs may vary.

Pass criteria: Every vehicle has a Merge tab with Fund ID and Investor ID for every participating investor, and every file name starts with the row's own IDs and refers to the current event.

Fail criteria: A vehicle has no Merge tab; an investor row lacks its IDs; or a file name carries another investor's IDs or refers to a prior event.

needs_review when a Merge tab has no File Name column or cannot be matched to a vehicle.
rules.description: Each vehicle has a Merge tab with Fund ID / Investor ID (and File Name in the doc-system format using the current event label).
rules.acceptance_criteria: Merge tab per vehicle with complete IDs; file names start with the row's own IDs and refer to the current event.

rules.name: No Template Placeholders Left
rules.query:
Using the COMPUTED FACTS (placeholder candidates and TBD cells, scanned on the processed sheets and every sheet they reference), check for unresolved template placeholders: sheet names wrapped in curly braces such as '{Fund Name}', and cell text such as '{{TOKEN}}', '{Fund Name}', '[LP Name]', '[XXX.XX]' or 'XXX' standing in for a real value. 'TBD' is a placeholder only when it stands in for a value the event uses (an amount, name, ID or date that event formulas reference). A 'TBD' on a status or date field that no event formula references, such as a wire date while cash has not moved yet, is legitimately pending.

Pass criteria: No placeholder sheet name or cell remains, and every TBD is a legitimately pending status.

Fail criteria: Any placeholder tab name or placeholder cell, or a TBD that event formulas reference. Report each occurrence with sheet and cell.

needs_review when bracketed text could be a legitimate label rather than a placeholder.
rules.description: No placeholder tabs ({Fund Name}, {Bank Name}, {GP Name}) or placeholder cell tokens survive in the delivered workbook.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No unresolved placeholders; TBD only on pending status/date fields that no event formula uses.

rules.name: No Hidden Populated Rows, Columns or Sheets
rules.description: Populated data on the Allocation/ITD sheets must not sit in hidden rows, columns or sheets.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No populated event data is hidden.

rules.name: Page Break Preview on Primary Sheets
rules.description: Allocation and ITD sheets are delivered in Page Break Preview.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Allocation and ITD sheets saved in Page Break Preview.

rules.name: Workbook File Naming
rules.description: The delivered workbook is named {fund_short}_{event_slug}_allocation_summary.xlsx and matches the event inside it.
rules.acceptance_criteria: File name follows the fund/event pattern and matches the current event.

rules.name: Investor Identity Ties Across Tabs
rules.description: Every participating investor's legal name ties exactly across the Allocation, Merge, DX Investor Data and fee tabs, and its Merge Investor ID / Fund ID (the DX IDs) matches the DX Investor Data tab. Investor IDs usually exist only on the Merge tab, so the other tabs are matched by exact name.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Exact name match on every tab; Merge Investor and Fund IDs found on the DX Investor Data tab under the same name.

rules.name: Management Fee Tie-Out (Allocation vs Fee Tab)
rules.description: The fee tab is the source of the management fees: each LP's fee on the Allocation sheet must equal its fee on the fee tab, the fee tab total must equal the Allocation fee driver, and the fee tab must be for the current period. The fee calculation itself (rate x basis, exempt investors) is checked against the fund terms (deferred CE-REF-MGMT-FEE-MATH).
rules.acceptance_criteria: Allocation fees = fee tab fees per LP; fee tab total = fee driver; the fee tab period matches the Allocation fee component.

rules.name: Current ITD Block Ties to Allocation
rules.description: The current event's ITD column block equals the Allocation sheet per investor and per component.
rules.acceptance_criteria: ITD current block = Allocation, per investor and per component, within $0.005.

rules.name: Commitments and Prior Contributions Tie (Allocation vs ITD)
rules.description: Commitments, prior contributions and remaining commitment agree between the Allocation roll-forward and the ITD sheet.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Commitment, prior contributions and remaining commitment tie across sheets within $0.01.

rules.name: Summary Ties to Allocation
rules.query:
You have the Summary sheet and the Allocation sheet in context. Compare: (1) Summary 'Total Fund Commitments' (and any per-vehicle commitment figures) vs. the Allocation vehicle / grand total commitments; (2) each Summary component amount (per vehicle and fund-level) vs. the Allocation component totals; (3) the Summary event total vs. the Allocation grand total; (4) the Summary notice date and due date vs. the dates on the Allocation sheet / event header. Normalize: remove '$', commas; treat parentheses as negative.

Pass criteria: Every compared figure matches (tolerance $0.005) and the dates agree.

Fail criteria: Any amount mismatch greater than $0.005 or any date disagreement (e.g. a stale prior-event date left on the Summary).

needs_review when a Summary line cannot be mapped unambiguously to an Allocation total.
rules.description: Summary commitments, component amounts, event total and dates agree with the Allocation sheet.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All Summary figures and dates equal their Allocation counterparts.

rules.name: Event Label and Date Consistency Across Tabs
rules.query:
Using the COMPUTED FACTS (every reference to the current event across the processed sheets: event labels, notice dates, due dates, ITD header dates, summary title, Merge letter and due dates and file names, and the fee periods with an explicit fee_period_mismatch flag), check that every tab describes the same current event. ITD event headers always show the due date, the date the items are recorded for accounting purposes, so compare them with the due date, not the notice date.

Pass criteria: Every reference resolves to the same event number, the same notice date and the same due date, and the fee periods agree (fee_period_mismatch is false).

Fail criteria: Any tab references a different event number or date for the current event, or the fee tab is for a different period than the Allocation fee component (stale prior-event metadata). Do not explain a mismatch away (e.g. as a catch-up); report it.

needs_review when a reference cannot be normalized to a specific date or event.
rules.description: The current event's label, number, notice date and due date are identical on every tab.
rules.acceptance_criteria: One event number, notice date, due date and fee period across all tabs.

rules.name: Net Event Call/Distribution Separation
rules.query:
Determine the event type from the workbook. If the current event is not a net event (a single event carrying both call-side and distribution-side components), return not_applicable.

For a net event: (1) call-side components (organizational expenses, management fees, investment reserves, other) and distribution-side components (return of capital, preferred return, catch-up, carry, other distribution) must sit in separate column blocks in the same workbook - never collapsed into one column without an explicit sign convention; (2) for each investor, net = call-side total - distribution-side total, with positive = investor owes and negative = investor receives; every investor in the register appears, even if it participates on only one side; (3) sum of per-investor nets = total call side - total distribution side; (4) gross = total call side + total distribution side ties to the stated event gross. Tolerance $0.005.

Pass criteria: Both blocks exist separately and all netting identities hold.

Fail criteria: The two sides are collapsed, a per-investor net is wrong or has an inverted direction, an investor is missing, or the net / gross totals do not reconcile.

needs_review when the sign convention used for the net column is not stated or cannot be inferred.
rules.description: For net events, call and distribution sides are kept in separate blocks and per-LP nets and totals reconcile with a clear sign convention.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Separate call/distribution blocks; per-LP net = call - distribution; net and gross totals reconcile.

rules.name: Carry Split GP vs LP
rules.query:
If the current event has no carry-distribution component, return not_applicable.

Capture the carry component total, the GP carried-interest rate (the 'Carried Interest Rate' column on the GP / carry block, or the stated carry %), and the GP and LP allocations of the carry component. (1) Expected GP share = carried-interest rate x carry component total; if several GP entities exist, split the GP share among them by their commitment ratio. (2) LP share = carry component x (1 - carried-interest rate), allocated pro-rata to LP contributed capital. (3) Catch-up, if present, is a separate component flowing to the GP and must not be double-counted in the carry column. Preserve sign: a negative carry (clawback) means a negative GP share and positive LP shares. Normalize: remove '$', commas, '%'; treat parentheses as negative.

Pass criteria: GP share equals the expected share penny-exact (tolerance $0.005); GP + LP shares sum to the carry component; LP shares are pro-rata to contributed capital within $2 per LP.

Fail criteria: GP share deviates from rate x carry total, the split does not sum to the component, catch-up is folded into carry, or signs are inconsistent.

needs_review when the carried-interest rate or the LP contributed-capital basis is not shown in the workbook, or a per-LP side-letter carry override may apply.
rules.description: The GP's share of a carry distribution equals the carried-interest rate times the carry component; the LP remainder is pro-rata to contributed capital.
rules.acceptance_criteria: GP carry = rate x carry component (penny-exact); GP + LP = component; LP shares pro-rata.

rules.name: Return of Capital Within Contributed Capital
rules.description: Return of capital per LP and in total cannot exceed contributed capital not yet returned.
rules.acceptance_criteria: No investor or total return of capital exceeds outstanding contributed capital.

rules.name: Allocation Pulls Correctly From Source Tabs
rules.query:
The Allocation sheet pulls figures from other tabs - typically the management fee tab (the source of the fees), an investment / deal tracker, holiday calendars or summary inputs. Using the COMPUTED FACTS (every reference from the Allocation sheet to another tab, with the target cell, its value, the labels on the target row, the header of the target column, the current event label and the current fee period, plus any period_mismatches), check that each reference points at the current event's figures: the current period's fee column, the row of the current deal or event, and the total rather than a subtotal or a prior-period cell. Only check that the figures are pulled correctly; the fee calculation itself is checked against the fund terms.

Pass criteria: Every reference points at the current event's figures and period_mismatches is empty.

Fail criteria: A reference points at a prior period, a prior deal or event, another investor's row, a subtotal instead of a total, or a sheet that does not exist. Name the Allocation cell and the target.

needs_review when the target's labels do not show which event or period it belongs to.
rules.description: Every tab the Allocation sheet references is pulled correctly: the right period, the right deal or event row, and totals rather than subtotals.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All Allocation references to other tabs point at the current event's figures.

rules.name: Prior Events Carried Over Unchanged
rules.description: Every event block in the prior event's ITD sheet - including what was then the current event - reappears in the current workbook with the same values for every investor. Needs the prior event's workbook; not applicable to the fund's first capital event.
rules.acceptance_criteria: All prior ITD event blocks are present and unchanged (within $0.005), and the prior current event is now a prior block.

rules.name: Roll-Forward Continues From the Prior Event
rules.description: Each investor's Prior Capital Contributions on the current Allocation sheet equal its contributions to date in the prior event's workbook (which include that event). Commitment changes since the prior event are flagged for review (transfers, new closes). Needs the prior event's workbook; not applicable to the fund's first capital event.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Prior contributions equal the prior workbook's contributions to date within $0.01 for every investor.

rules.name: Plug Pattern Consistent With the Prior Event
rules.description: Clients differ in how they place the rounding residual (one investor, or spread across the largest), but each fund should do it the same way every event. The plug pattern per component (single or spread, and which investors) must match the prior event's workbook. Needs the prior event's workbook; not applicable to the fund's first capital event.
rules.acceptance_criteria: Per component, the same plug style as the prior event; a move to other investors is flagged for review.
